answer: Public daily work journals stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent posts a daily log of jobs, signed by the client, so history stays public. Second, two clients countersign weekly, and an unsigned gap flags the account. Third, three missing weeks freeze work and forfeit a $25 bond. Fourth, a fake journal voids a year of standing and bars re-entry. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 journals plus $25,000 in bonds and $30,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust climbs like a dune toward a summit, written daily with a quill, like a stallholder whose ledger neighbours read each dawn.
